preferences.name: libraryFolder
preferences.title: Library Folder
preferences.description: Folder where Affipill stores audio and cover files. Leave empty to use the default Affipill folder. Existing library files move here the next time you open Affipill.

commands.name: affipill
commands.title: Affipill
commands.subtitle: Play your favourite affirmation tracks
commands.description: Select an affirmation track and play it in the background.

commands.name: add-tracks-via-ai
commands.title: Add New Tracks Via AI
commands.subtitle: Affipill
commands.description: Import audio and covers, then let AI clean titles and match artwork.

commands.name: stop-playback
commands.title: Stop Affipill Playback
commands.description: Stop the currently playing affirmation track.

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.description: Show the currently playing affirmation track in the menu bar.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
